 Rybakina's only defeat in her last ten matches came against Alina Charaeva, then ranked 118th, in the middle of a stretch that notably included wins over Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff, and Naomi Osaka.
 Putintseva's two losses in her last ten matches were both conceded to the same opponent, Diana Shnaider, in Ningbo and then in Wuhan.
 Rybakina just won Ningbo after playing four matches in four days, from October 22 to 25, before arriving in Tokyo.
 Was this useful? Yes No Match preview
 World No. 1 Elena Rybakina plays in Tokyo needing a win to secure the year-end No. 1 ranking. The Kazakh comes in on a four-match winning streak, with nine wins from her last ten matches. Across the net, qualifier Yulia Putintseva has already won three matches in this event, including one against No. 30 seed Maria Sakkari.
The head-to-head is perfectly balanced at 2-2, with a 1-1 record on hard courts. Their last meeting, in Miami in March 2026, ended with a 63 63 win for Rybakina.
Serve statistics offer a concrete point of comparison: in their last match, Rybakina landed 67% of first serves and converted four of five break points, versus 74% and seven of sixteen for Putintseva. Was this useful? Yes No Last meeting
 Their last meeting came on March 21, 2026, in Miami, on hard courts. Elena Rybakina defeated Yulia Putintseva in two sets, 63 63, in 77 minutes.
